body: R39 THE SANCTIONING SPINE is on master (42e9261). Godot/scripts/Sanctioning.gd is live: rules_for(organization, discipline, overrides) returns {ruleset_id, competition_ruleset_id, authority, evidence, fallback}; ruleset_id_for() is the playable id alone; bout_ruleset_id(event, bout, discipline) is the read side of the event stamp. All 18 orgs in real_organizations.json now carry default_ruleset_id, ruleset_ids, competition_ruleset_id, authority and evidence (catalog_version 2), and WorldPopulation copies them onto the world organization record. C24 never re-derives rules: call Sanctioning.rules_for and render what it returns. Note evidence can be UNKNOWN and competition_ruleset_id can be empty for ONE, RIZIN, GLORY, Karate Combat and RWS - that is honest, render it as such, do not hide the row. Suite 134/134.
